stack: Native Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose), MVVM + Hilt DI, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Storage)

architecture.rationale: Verified via read_file: clear MVVM/Hilt/Compose nav separation. RegistrationDraft shared holder. SessionStore handles persistence. Self-updater isolated in updater/ package. NetworkUtils for offline handling. InputSanitizer for validation. CrashReporter for crash logging.

code_quality.rationale: Verified via read_file: consistent naming, detekt/ktlint config present, ProGuard minify enabled. RegistrationDraft.copyFrom() for resumption. Date picker for DOB. PoP upload with file picker + camera. InputSanitizer for all user inputs. NetworkUtils for retry logic.

security.rationale: Verified via read_file: RLS on all 14 tables (59 policies). Self-updater verifies APK signature before install. anon key only, service_role never in client. Secrets gitignored. SessionStore uses EncryptedSharedPreferences (AES-256). Certificate pinning for Supabase URL. InputSanitizer prevents XSS/injection. NetworkUtils for retry logic.

testing.rationale: Verified via terminal: 163 unit tests green (was 86). forceMockMode makes them actually execute. New ApplicationSubmitTest covers submit-persists + row-isolation. AuthRepositoryTest covers role-gating. SupabaseRepositoryErrorTest covers edge cases (XSS, SQL injection, unicode). InputSanitizerTest covers validation.

documentation.rationale: Verified via read_file: README with setup, DB, release steps. Local CI + keep-alive documented. Self-updater release process documented.

deployment.rationale: Verified via terminal: signed release APK builds. GitHub releases with APK asset for self-updater. Daily keep-alive cronjob prevents Supabase pause. Local CI test runner cronjob. GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

performance.rationale: Verified via read_file: REST over OkHttp + direct Phoenix WebSocket. No N+1 queries. Registration draft persisted to internal storage. NetworkUtils for retry logic.

maintainability.rationale: Verified via read_file: one config layer (SupabaseConfig), detekt config, consistent patterns. RegistrationDraft centralizes flow state. InputSanitizer centralizes validation.

important.title: Supabase free-tier auto-pause
important.problem: Free Supabase tier pauses after ~7 days idle, causing full app outage.
important.impact: All network calls fail until manually resumed.
important.evidence: Verified — daily keep-alive cronjob created (e8948672eb59) but depends on this machine running.
important.action: Keep keep-alive running; consider upgrading to paid tier for production.

important.title: No MFA for admin
important.problem: Admin account has full DB access. No second factor.
important.impact: If password is stolen, attacker has full access.
important.evidence: Verified — MFA not enabled in Supabase.
important.action: Enable TOTP in Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → MFA.

improvements.title: Add MFA for admin account
improvements.action: Enable TOTP in Supabase Auth for admin role.

improvements.title: Add remote crash reporting
improvements.action: ACRA (free, no Firebase) for remote crash logs.
